 Order

This writ petition has been filed to direct the respondents to consider the representation of the petitioner dated 24.11.2023 for enhancement of compensation in terms of the judgment rendered LAOP.No.2597 of 1998 batch dated 02.09.2015 on the file of the Sub Court, Ponneri in respect of lands in Survey No.794 measuring 0.70 cents at Madhavaram Village, then Saidapet Taluk that was acquired for the formation of bus and truck terminal by the MMDA (now CMDA).
2.

It is the grievance of the writ petitioner that the land of the first petitioner's husband has been acquired by the Government for the purpose of formation of bus and truck terminal by the MMDA (now CMDA) and https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis awarded compensation and the compensation received by the petitioner is under protest.
In this regard, the petitioner has raised objections and made reference under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act for enhancement of compensation.
Whereas, for the adjacent land owners, whose lands have been acquired, have been referred to Land Acquisition Tribunal and they have been granted enhanced compensation.
The appeals filed in A.S.Nos.431 to 477 of 2016 on the file of this Court filed as against the Order of the Tribunal have also been dismissed confirming the enhancement made by the Tribunal.
Therefore, once again, the petitioners have given representation on 24.11.2023 and the same has not been considered by the respondents.

3. Heard Mr.R.Navaneeth Krishnan, learned counsel for the petitioners; Mr.A.Selvendran, learned Special Government Pleader for the respondents 1 and 3 and Mrs.R.Veena Suresh, learned counsel for the second respondent.
4. Considering the fact that the District Collector has to make reference under section 28 [A] [1] and [2] of Land Acquisition Act, the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis District Collector, Chennai is directed to refer the matter to the tribunal for enhancement of compensation with all other benefits as per Land Acquisition Act and in the light of the decree and judgment rendered in LAOP.No.2597 of 1998 batch dated 02.09.2015 on the file of the Sub Court, Ponneri.
5.
With the above directions, this Writ Petition stands disposed of.
